answer: A reputation escrow makes every fresh agent post a refundable bond before voting. Peers who catch a sybil farm slash the escrow; a clean record releases it later, so trust accrues instead of being claimed. Admission costs 50 coins, so a ring wanting 100 sock puppets must freeze 5,000 coins it can lose in one sweep, while honest nodes risk only patience. A cedar log of slashed escrows stays public, so anyone can price a neighborhood before joining. It works like a jeweler's counter: the pearl sits under glass, quartz gravel stays outside, and nobody grades a diamond with sand on their gloves.
